### Added
- **Preset `qwen3-8-flash-next-nvfp4`: Qwen3.8-Flash-Next NVFP4 on one 128 GB unified-memory Blackwell node, served from an OCI model image on an installation-defined runtime** (giantswarm/agent-platform#553). Qwen3.8-Flash-Next (125B total, 6B active, a 51B n-gram embedding table, 262k context, tools, reasoning, vision) had no shipped preset: NVIDIA's NVFP4 checkpoint is 123.6 GiB on disk and does not fit the node next to a KV cache. The new preset serves the quantization-aware-distilled repack `local-inference-lab/Qwen3.8-Flash-Next-NVFP4` (98.6 GiB, the n-gram table in NVFP4 too) with the community's single-node recipe: the table read from disk (`VLLM_PLE_TABLE_MEMORY=disk`), MTP speculative decoding (`--speculative-config='{"method":"mtp","num_speculative_tokens":4}'`), the B12X load format, GDN decode kernel, linear and MoE backends, `--quantization=modelopt_mixed`, `--kv-cache-dtype=fp8`, `--mamba-cache-mode=align`, prefix caching, chunked prefill, `--max-model-len=262144`, `--max-num-seqs=8`, `--max-num-batched-tokens=4096`, `--gpu-memory-utilization=0.80`, the `qwen3` reasoning parser, tools on with the `qwen3_xml` parser, fused activation quantization (`--compilation-config='{"pass_config":{"fuse_act_quant":true}}'`); nine runtime knobs (`CUTE_DSL_ARCH=sm_121a`, `SAFETENSORS_FAST_GPU`, `VLLM_WORKER_MULTIPROC_METHOD=spawn`, `VLLM_SSM_CONV_STATE_LAYOUT=DS`, the AOT compile flags, `VLLM_USE_V2_MODEL_RUNNER`, `B12X_POLICY_MODE=auto`) plus `HOME`, `HF_HOME` and `VLLM_CACHE_ROOT` under `/tmp`, because the modelcar path runs the runtime as a non-root uid on a read-only image; requests 4 vCPU / 48 GiB, limits 8 / 64 GiB; `weightsGiB: 99` (the Hub's size), `overheadGiB: 20` (the table stays on disk, so about 74 GiB are resident and the rest of the 0.80 budget is the KV cache); `predictor.timeout: 1800`; licence `other` (the Qwen community licence). Two firsts among the shipped presets: `spec.runtime: kserve-vllm-b12x` names an additional runtime the installation defines from the B12X image through `modelServing.additionalRuntimes` (giantswarm/agent-platform#550) — the default upstream runtime cannot serve this architecture, and without the entry the InferenceService names a runtime that does not exist — and `spec.model.storageUri` is `oci://gsoci.azurecr.io/giantswarm/models/qwen3-8-flash-next-nvfp4:7c4f1bc1a2d6` (the tag the first 12 characters of the checkpoint revision), the model as an OCI image a registry holds under that path, its host swapped by `modelServing.modelImages.registry` and pre-pulled through `modelServing.prepull.modelPresets` (giantswarm/agent-platform#551). `make verify-wiring` expects eleven shipped presets; `verify-preset-weights` and the eval check of `verify-serving-slice` cover the new file; `verify-gpu-pool` leaves the preset's ConfigMap and its discovery entry out of the golden comparison while `origin/main` predates it.
